targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Mill' AS station, l.location_id, l.path, g.name, v.value_num, v.ts FROM umh.value_cnc v JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_cnc' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','good_count','scrap_count') AND $__timeFilter(v.ts) UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, 'Wash' AS station, l.location_id, l.path, g.name, v.value_num, v.ts FROM umh.value_washing v JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_washing' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','good_count','scrap_count') AND $__timeFilter(v.ts) UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ord, 'Harden' AS station, l.location_id, l.path, g.name, v.value_num, v.ts FROM umh.value_oven v JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_oven' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','good_count','scrap_count') AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)), st AS (SELECT ord, station, location_id, path, (array_agg(value_num ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS state_now, avg(CASE WHEN value_num = 10 OR value_num >= 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS availability FROM base WHERE name = 'state' GROUP BY ord, station, location_id, path), q AS (SELECT location_id, max(CASE WHEN name='good_count' THEN value_num END) - min(CASE WHEN name='good_count' THEN value_num END) AS good_d, max(CASE WHEN name='scrap_count' THEN value_num END) - min(CASE WHEN name='scrap_count' THEN value_num END) AS scrap_d FROM base WHERE name IN ('good_count','scrap_count') GROUP BY location_id) SELECT CASE st.station WHEN 'Mill' THEN 'cnc' WHEN 'Wash' THEN 'washing' ELSE 'oven' END AS kind, subltree(st.path, nlevel(st.path)-2, nlevel(st.path)-1)::text AS line, st.ord AS ord, st.station AS station, subltree(st.path, nlevel(st.path)-1, nlevel(st.path))::text AS machine, st.state_now AS state, st.availability AS availability, CASE WHEN coalesce(q.good_d,0) + coalesce(q.scrap_d,0) > 0 THEN q.good_d / (q.good_d + q.scrap_d) END AS quality, st.path::text AS path FROM st LEFT JOIN q ON q.location_id = st.location_id ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT l.path, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_cnc' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.path, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_washing v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_washing' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.path, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_oven v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_oven' AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
),
x AS (SELECT path, ts, value_num, time_bucket(greatest(interval '10 seconds',
                     ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) / 48), ts) AS bucket FROM s)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (path, bucket) path::text AS path, bucket AS bucket,
       value_num AS state
FROM x
ORDER BY path, bucket, ts DESC

WITH m(contract, vpath, tag, ord, label, unit) AS (VALUES
    ('_cnc',     'tool',       'life_pct',             1, 'tool life',        '%'),
    ('_cnc',     'tool',       'number',               2, 'tool no',          ''),
    ('_cnc',     'spindle',    'load_pct',             3, 'spindle load',     '%'),
    ('_cnc',     'coolant',    'level_pct',            4, 'coolant level',    '%'),
    ('_cnc',     'coolant',    'pressure_bar',         5, 'coolant pressure', 'bar'),
    ('_cnc',     'measurement','diameter_mm',          6, 'diameter',         'mm'),
    ('_washing', 'bath',       'temp_c',               1, 'bath temp',        'C'),
    ('_washing', 'bath',       'detergent_level_pct',  2, 'detergent',        '%'),
    ('_washing', 'bath',       'conductivity_us_cm',   3, 'conductivity',     'uS/cm'),
    ('_washing', 'pump',       'pressure_bar',         4, 'pump pressure',    'bar'),
    ('_washing', 'pump',       'flow_rate_l_min',      5, 'flow',             'l/min'),
    ('_washing', 'basket',     'number',               6, 'basket no',        ''),
    ('_oven',    'chamber',    'temp_c',               1, 'chamber temp',     'C'),
    ('_oven',    'chamber',    'setpoint_temp_c',      2, 'setpoint',         'C'),
    ('_oven',    'chamber',    'heater_power_pct',     3, 'heater',           '%'),
    ('_oven',    'atmosphere', 'carbon_potential_pct', 4, 'carbon potential', '%'),
    ('_oven',    'batch',      'number',               5, 'batch no',         ''),
    ('_oven',    'batch',      'phase_remaining_s',    6, 'phase left',       's')
),
d AS (
  SELECT l.path, m.ord, m.label, m.unit, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
    JOIN m ON m.contract = g.data_contract_name
          AND m.vpath = g.virtual_path AND m.tag = g.name
  WHERE $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.path, m.ord, m.label, m.unit, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_washing v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
    JOIN m ON m.contract = g.data_contract_name
          AND m.vpath = g.virtual_path AND m.tag = g.name
  WHERE $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.path, m.ord, m.label, m.unit, v.ts, v.value_num
  FROM umh.value_oven v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
    JOIN m ON m.contract = g.data_contract_name
          AND m.vpath = g.virtual_path AND m.tag = g.name
  WHERE $__timeFilter(v.ts)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (path, ord) path::text AS path, ord, label, unit,
         value_num AS value
  FROM d
  ORDER BY path, ord, ts DESC
) z
ORDER BY path, ord
